title: Desktop harness: choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Night Galley. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Night Galley
options.lineage: Printer's galley proofs and proofreader's marks
options.thesis: The model sets the copy; the controller proofs it in the margin; you pass it for press.
options.viewport: Numbered galley rail on the left, the chat as a galley column with the controller's margin beside every reply, patch inline as a struck/caret strip, composer docked below.
options.risk: Proof-mark vocabulary is unfamiliar; if the margin ever shows a mark the controller did not make, the world turns into costume.

raised.raise: Every proposal carries a galley number from its session id, the same in the rail, the diff header and the transcript.
Three type sizes total; rank comes from weight, case and one reversed plate per screen.
The pass-green appears only on Apply and on a verified apply, nowhere else.
Every session in the rail carries the same fixed furniture: number, title, model, verdict line.

options.label: Interlocking
options.thesis: No route clears until every lever locks: scope, lint, checks, then the signal goes green.
options.viewport: Chat in the centre; above the composer a route strip of track segments with lamps for Proposal, Scope, Lint, Checks and Applied; diff slides in on the right when a route is offered.
options.risk: The most literal reading of a safety gate, and a control-panel world on a working screen drifts toward costume.

options.label: Night Line
options.thesis: Each session is a line; every gate is a station it must call at before it reaches Applied.
options.viewport: Standard shell; the session's lifecycle runs as one coloured line across the top of the transcript, stations lit as the controller confirms them.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: gates map onto stations and holds product clarity; loses on audience identification.
options.risk: Line colours compete with diff red and green unless the diff is held monochrome.

options.label: Emission Rail
options.lineage: Glass spectrograms on a viewing box
options.thesis: Evidence is a line form, not a colour: solid verified, dashed pending, half-height stale, struck refused.
options.viewport: One off-centre rail runs the height of the window; every gate and telemetry value is a mark on it beside the transcript.
options.case: Its state grammar is the strongest non-colour evidence encoding on the table; loses on audience identification.
options.risk: Its one-size type rule fights long model replies; the rail can read as decoration if marks are not live.

options.label: Catalog Sleeve
options.thesis: Every artifact gets a catalog number; names give way to code.
options.viewport: Black field, one plot, a numbered index.
options.case: Coded labels hide state on a screen that must state it plainly; loses both axes.

options.label: Timetable Rack
options.thesis: One type size; rank carried by weight, case and reversal.
options.viewport: A raked rack of slides travelled laterally.
options.case: Raked containers and lateral travel break a chat transcript; loses both axes.
options.risk: Novel structure over a familiar task.
options.kept: Rank by weight and case, not by a ladder of sizes.

options.label: Warm Consumer App
options.thesis: Soft cards, one action colour only where something can be done.
options.viewport: Single column of soft cards with a bottom bar.
options.case: Toy-like and daylight-bright for a night pro tool; loses both axes.
options.risk: Exactly the consumer feel you ruled out.
options.kept: Action colour reserved for what can actually be pressed.

options.label: Character Catalog
options.thesis: A ranked cast, each with a name plate and fixed personal furniture.
options.viewport: A pastel grid of ranked mascots.
options.case: Mascots trivialise a safety gate; loses both axes.
options.kept: Fixed furniture on every session entry.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: An editor-style dark agent panel, done with full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Activity bar, sessions list, agent chat panel, diff opening as an editor tab.
canonCard.risk: Reads like Cursor or Copilot Chat by design.
